meta.title: Jellyfish theme
meta.description: Independent JELEE Purple / Blue palettes with host components locked to dark mode while enabled; animated scenery, opaque panels and JELEE HARNESS branding. Restores the host appearance on disable. Transparent header actions, New Session and user bubbles; The transcript is clipped beneath the composer while the original gradient and waves remain visible.

appearance.title: JELEE appearance
appearance.hint: Choose Purple or Blue independently. Components stay dark while enabled; the previous host appearance returns on disable.
appearance.running: Motion is on: bubbles rise and fish swim across JELEE Blue.
appearance.reduced: Your system reduces motion, so the background is still. Choose Animate to play.
appearance.unsaved: Applied for now, but could not save. Reopening will restore the previous setting.
appearance.fontHint: Chinese falls back to locally installed 猫啃珠圆体 (interface) and 975 圆体 (code). Both ship in fonts/.
